Invalid URL or model. Use HTTPS, or explicitly allow HTTP for a supported loopback address. The URL must not contain credentials, query parameters or fragments.

Connect to an OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible text service. Enter its /v1 base URL or complete /v1/chat/completions URL and model ID. The service must accept model, messages and stream: false, and return complete choices[0].message.content. Leave the API key empty if authentication is not required.\n\nConfigurations from the former combined entry remain here. ChatMock now has its own entry with a separate URL, model and key.

Start your ChatMock service, then enter a model ID returned by /v1/models. The default http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 refers to this phone or emulator, not your computer. To use ChatMock on a computer, enter its HTTPS address. For development, use adb reverse tcp:8000 tcp:8000, or http://10.0.2.2:8000/v1 in an Android emulator. Local HTTP still requires explicit permission.\n\nLocal describes only the ChatMock endpoint. Translation models run online through the account signed in to ChatMock, not on the phone or computer. Recommended server options: --reasoning-compat legacy --reasoning-summary none. Leave the API key empty unless authentication is required. Do not enter a ChatGPT password or login token; sign in through ChatMock.

Alibaba Cloud Audio 3.0 recognizes speech; Qwen-MT translates the text using the speech API key above. Lite and Flash stream translations; Plus returns complete text. Save and use applies the configuration.
Show only recognized original text, without calling a text translation service. Save to apply this choice.
The selected speech service recognizes audio; the text translation service receives only recognized text. Speech recognition and each text service keep separate keys.

Use the official DeepL translation API with a separate DeepL API key. Free keys ending in :fx use api-free.deepl.com; other keys use api.deepl.com. Mimi selects the official URL automatically, so no URL or model is needed. The speech key is never used for DeepL.

Connect to your own DeepLX service. Enter a translation endpoint ending in /translate; this suffix is added if missing. No model is needed. Enter a token only if the service requires Bearer authentication.\n\nThe service must accept text, source_lang and target_lang, and return code: 200 with translated text in data. DeepLX and the official DeepL API use different endpoints and authentication.

Use HTTPS for remote services. 127.0.0.1 and localhost refer to the current phone or emulator itself. Unencrypted local HTTP requires permission and is limited to localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1] and emulator host 10.0.2.2. Developers can forward a computer port with adb reverse. Changing a service or URL never borrows another service key or reuses the old destination key.
